rules.reason: a shop nobody can reach without signing in is not a shop; the page is public and every write it makes goes through the cart/checkout objects, which scope everything to the caller's session token
putting something in a basket must not require an account -- the session token says which basket, never who

guest checkout is the default; requiring signup before purchase is the single biggest conversion loss in small-business retail. The order it creates is a DRAFT and nothing is paid or shipped by this call
